title: Woe to Those Who Go Down to Egypt

questions.question: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:1 (ESV): "Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on horses,"

questions.question: Who trust in chariots because they are many and in horsemen because they are very what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:1 (ESV): "and in horsemen because they are very strong,"

questions.question: But do not look to the Holy One of Israel or consult whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:1 (ESV): "but do not look to the Holy One of Israel or consult the LORD!"

questions.question: The Egyptians are man, and not God; and their horses are flesh, and not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:3 (ESV): "and their horses are flesh, and not spirit."

questions.question: When the LORD stretches out his hand, the helper will stumble, and he who is helped will what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:3 (ESV): "and he who is helped will fall,"

questions.question: Like birds hovering, so the LORD of hosts will protect whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:5 (ESV): "so the LORD of hosts will protect Jerusalem;"

questions.question: Turn to him from whom people have deeply revolted, O children of whom?
For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of what?
And the Assyrian shall fall by a sword, not of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:8 (ESV): "And the Assyrian shall fall by a sword, not of man;"

questions.question: And his rock shall pass away in terror, and his officers desert the standard in panic," declares the LORD, whose fire is in where?
And whose furnace is in where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:9 (ESV): "and whose furnace is in Jerusalem."

questions.question: And the sword, not of man, shall do what to him?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:8 (ESV): "and a sword, not of man, shall devour him;"

questions.question: And he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be put to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:8 (ESV): "and his young men shall be put to forced labor."

questions.question: Like a lion or a young lion growols over his prey, and when a band of shepherds is called out against him he is not terrified by their what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 31:4 (ESV): "he is not terrified by their shouting"

questions.question: So the LORD of hosts will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its what?

key_verse_text: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help and rely on horses, who trust in chariots because they are many and in horsemen because they are very strong, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel or consult the LORD!
